changes.text: Shop ALL now uses Book. Unsold stock counts at what it cost, so a restock no longer pushes a shop down the board. Goods still pay storage, and spoiled food leaves Book at its cost. Shop ALL = 0.5 book + 0.3 revenue + 0.2 stars. Stock still counts at cost when the round ends.
